Two-Story Office Thermal Zone Model

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an OpenStudio 3.10 two-story office model and save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.osm with size at least 500 bytes and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json with size at least 10 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10.
3. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:Building, 2 OS:BuildingStory objects, 10 OS:Space objects, and 10 OS:ThermalZone objects.
4. The OS:Space names are exactly L1-South, L1-North, L1-West, L1-East, L1-Core, L2-South, L2-North, L2-West, L2-East, and L2-Core.
5. Every OS:Space references an OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, has Part of Total Floor Area set to Yes, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2.
6. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains at least one OS:DefaultConstructionSet and the single OS:Building references a default construction set.
7. The model has exactly 68 OS:Surface objects: 10 Floor surfaces, 10 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 48 Wall surfaces.
8. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 10 Ground, 26 Outdoors, and 32 Surface.
9. The model has exactly 16 OS:SubSurface objects, all counted window subsurfaces are FixedWindow, and the fixed-window count is exactly 16.
10. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 30.00 m, Y span 18.00 m, and Z span 7.00 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
11. The sum of floor surface areas is 1080.00 m2 with tolerance +/-1.00 m2.
12. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 576.00 m2 with tolerance +/-1.00 m2.
13. The total fixed-window area is 201.60 m2 with tolerance +/-1.00 m2.
14. The model contains exactly 10 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem objects, 10 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList objects, and 10 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint objects; every thermal zone is referenced by an equipment list and a thermostat, and every equipment list references an ideal loads system.
15. /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json contains total_floor_area_m2, zone_count, total_exterior_wall_area_m2, and total_window_area_m2 values matching the evaluator-computed model metrics with tolerance max(0.10, 1%).

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
